decision.label: Keep the library in use
decision.text: The reading chair can stay by the south window while someone else browses the north bookcase. Decide whether the extra shelf space is worth fitting now.
decision.basis: Fictional library brief and checked existing plan L-01.

options.label: Keep the bookcase as it is
options.text: Retain the chair, lamp and existing storage. The household can use the room immediately without drilling the wall.

options.label: Add two oak shelves
options.text: Two 875 mm shelves would add storage. Confirm the fixing positions and nearby socket before deciding to order.
options.basis: Library shopping line L02. This option has a purchase hold.

phasing.label: Measure, then decide
phasing.text: The installer checks the wall construction and socket position. The homeowner can then choose between retaining the bookcase alone and releasing the shelf order.
phasing.basis: Library shopping issue SHOP, hold on L02. Fitting and making good are unpriced.
